method: Actual QueuePanel mounted in a React fixture and original playback IPC proxy. Delayed mirror is modeled by replaying only old UI queue data after an actual host mutation; proxy methods stay intact. Drag uses DOM DragEvent/DataTransfer, including a real React rerender between dragstart and drop. Four indexed local 120-second WAV tracks avoid platform accounts. Targets distinguish source+ID, not identical duplicate instances.

environment.entry: npm run dev; isolated userData; normal React imports; generated local WAV
